one_liner: API-first customer support platform for B2B SaaS companies.

evidence.claim: API authentication uses machine-user API keys sent as a Bearer header
API keys are self-serve, generated inside the Plain workspace settings
evidence.quote: Your API key: This gives your system permission to talk to Plain. You can generate one from Settings → API Keys in your Plain workspace.

evidence.claim: A free trial is available, so a developer can obtain a workspace and credentials without sales
evidence.quote: [Start a free trial](../get/trial) or [book a demo](../get/demo)

evidence.claim: Single GraphQL endpoint covering the full product surface
evidence.quote: Plain's API gives your team access to the same powerful tools our own product is built on.

evidence.claim: Official hosted MCP server with OAuth and 30 tools
evidence.quote: The Plain MCP server at`https://mcp.plain.com/mcp` lets tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor work with your support data directly.

notes: Official MCP server at https://mcp.plain.com/mcp uses OAuth (authenticates as an existing Plain user, inherits that user's permissions) and exposes 30 tools; direct API auth is per-machine-user API keys with fine-grained permissions. GraphQL endpoint is https://core-api.uk.plain.com/graphql/v1 with downloadable schema; typed TypeScript SDK @team-plain/graphql on npm. mTLS is supported for webhook delivery and customer-card requests. Breadth covers customers, companies, tenants, threads, messaging, help center, labels, tiers/SLAs, snippets, tasks, events, and webhook targets (broad). Note trial credentials require creating a workspace first.
